messages.text:
Yes. Apple Pay shows at checkout when you're on an iPhone, iPad or Safari on a Mac. If it doesn't appear on your device, card and PayPal are there too.

Want me to put the Hammer DC06 in a cart for you, or are you still weighing it up?
I’m trying to use Apple Pay but cant

Most likely it's the browser. Apple Pay only appears in Safari on an iPhone, iPad or Mac, with a card already added to Wallet on that device. Chrome or an in-app browser won't show it.

Is the button missing entirely, or does it appear and then fail?
It’s missing. I am on safari on an iphone

Next most likely: Private Browsing hides Apple Pay in Safari. Close the private tab, open the site in a normal one, and check Settings > Apple Pay has a card in Wallet for that iPhone.

Does the button show up in a normal tab?
